nfl.pass_run_split_epa_both_sides.reviewed_by: Agent certification review (Claude), Phase 7, 2026-11-15; not human verified.

catalog_clauses.clause: regular-season plays excluding kneels, spikes and plays with pre-play wp below 0.05 or above 0.95 (no-spread nflfastR wp)
catalog_clauses.note: season_type REG, pass==1 or rush==1, qb_kneel/qb_spike != 1, epa present, 0.05 <= wp <= 0.95 (nflfastR wp is the no-spread model; vegas_wp is not used). Computed from 1999, a superset of the catalog's 2016+ window, so the catalog history 1999-2025 is covered

catalog_clauses.clause: off EPA per dropback, off EPA per rush, def EPA per dropback faced, def EPA per rush faced
catalog_clauses.note: dropback = nflfastR pass flag (includes sacks and scrambles); rush = designed runs

catalog_clauses.clause: each opponent-adjusted by ridge over the last 12 games with exp half-life 6 games
catalog_clauses.note: per cutoff date and kind, closed-form weighted ridge y = b0 + a_offence + d_defence (penalty 50 play-equivalents on team effects); a game observation enters when it is in the offence's or the defence's last 12 regular-season games; weight = plays x 0.5^(min rank / 6)

catalog_clauses.clause: shrunk to league mean with weight n/(n+150) for pass and n/(n+100) for rush (n = plays)
catalog_clauses.note: league mean = ridge intercept b0; n = unweighted plays of the team's entering observations on that side

catalog_clauses.clause: pA = A's neutral-situation pass rate = league expected pass rate (nfl.proe model) + A's PROE, as of last completed game
catalog_clauses.note: expected pass model = nflfastR xpass (the published nflverse expected-pass model, present from 2006; earlier seasons NaN); neutral = qtr <= 3, 0.20 <= wp <= 0.80; PROE weighted over the team's last 12 games with half-life 6

catalog_clauses.clause: Expected EPA/play for team A vs B = pA x (offA_pass - defB_pass) + (1-pA) x (offA_rush - defB_rush); output four components plus the blended rate
catalog_clauses.note: defence columns are EPA ALLOWED per play (higher = worse); the catalog formula is applied with defence expressed as EPA prevented relative to league (b0 - allowed), i.e. offA + allowedB - b0 per kind

nfl.pass_run_split_epa_both_sides.timing_rule: values for a game dated d are computed from plays of regular-season games dated strictly before d (per-date refit); replay truncation (3 cuts), future perturbation (3 seeds), own-game and non-vacuity gates pass
nfl.pass_run_split_epa_both_sides.required_history: 1999-2025 (catalog); replay span 1999-09-19 .. 2026-11-12 (first rows with values); prs_pass_rate_pre / prs_exp_epa_pre from 2006 (xpass)

nfl.rush_yardage_tail.reviewed_by: Agent certification review (Claude), Phase 7, 2026-11-15; not human verified.

catalog_clauses.clause: For rushers (RB and QB separately) fit a discrete tail: P(yards>=k per carry) for k in {7, 10, 15, 20, 30, 40}
catalog_clauses.note: carries = rush_attempt rows excluding kneels; group QB from the nflverse players file, every other rusher RB

catalog_clauses.clause: on 3 seasons of carries, half-life 25 carries
catalog_clauses.note: seasons s-2..s dated before the game; weight 0.5^(carries-ago / 25)

catalog_clauses.clause: shrink to positional prior with k=60 carries
catalog_clauses.note: prior = the group's share over the same 3-season window, dated before the game

catalog_clauses.clause: adjust by opponent run-defence tail rate (stuff and explosive-allowed) with k=100 carries
catalog_clauses.note: explosive-allowed rate per threshold shrunk to league with k=100 carries (seasons s-1..s) multiplies each tail probability as a ratio to league; stuff (yards <= 0) allowed rate shrunk the same way is output as a ratio to league
every window ends strictly before the game date

nfl.rush_yardage_tail.timing_rule: carries of games dated strictly before the game date; role-preserving perturbation (per-carry yardage permuted, rusher/team identities fixed) for truncation-perturbation, own-game and non-vacuity, as for tennis
